actions.create_inbox.description: Create a new email inbox on LobsterMail.
actions.create_inbox.props.displayName.d: A friendly label for the inbox (e.g. "Support Inbox"). Only visible inside LobsterMail.
actions.create_inbox.props.domain.descri: The domain for the inbox address. Leave empty to use the default lobstermail.ai. Custom domains require a Tier 2+ account and prior DNS configuration.
actions.create_inbox.props.localPart.des: The part before the @ in the email address (e.g. "support" → support@lobstermail.ai). Use only lowercase letters, numbers, dots, hyphens, or underscores. Leave empty to auto-generate a random address.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_inbox.description: Permanently delete an inbox and release its address. This action cannot be undone.
actions.get_account.description: Get account details including subscription tier, usage, and sending limits.
actions.get_email.description: Get a single email with full body content.
actions.get_email.props.email_id.descrip: The ID of the email to retrieve (starts with eml_). You can get this from the "List Emails" action or the "New Email Received" trigger output.
actions.get_inbox.description: Get details for a single inbox including its address, status, and settings.
actions.list_emails.description: List emails in a specific inbox.
actions.list_emails.props.direction.desc: Filter by inbound (received) or outbound (sent) emails.
actions.list_emails.props.limit.descript: Maximum number of emails to return (1–50, default 20).
actions.list_inboxes.description: List all email inboxes on the account.
actions.search_emails.description: Search emails across inboxes using full-text search and optional filters. Rate limited to 30 requests/minute.
actions.search_emails.props.direction.de: Filter by inbound (received) or outbound (sent) emails.
actions.search_emails.props.from.descrip: Filter results to emails from a specific sender address (partial match supported).
actions.search_emails.props.has_attachme: Return only emails that have attachments.
actions.search_emails.props.inbox_id.des: Limit results to a specific inbox. Leave empty to search all inboxes.
actions.search_emails.props.limit.descri: Maximum number of results to return (1–50, default 20).
actions.search_emails.props.query.descri: Text to search for. Searches email subjects (highest priority), senders, and body previews.
actions.send_email.description: Send an email from one of your LobsterMail inboxes. Requires a verified account (Tier 1+).
actions.send_email.props.body_html.descr: HTML version of the email. If only HTML is provided, a plain-text version is auto-generated.
actions.send_email.props.body_text.descr: Plain text version of the email. At least one of Plain Text or HTML body is required.
actions.send_email.props.cc.description: Additional recipients to CC on the email.
actions.send_email.props.from.descriptio: Select the inbox to send from. Must be an active inbox on your account.
actions.send_email.props.in_reply_to.des: Message-ID of the email you are replying to (for threading). You can get this from the "Get Email" action output.
actions.send_email.props.thread_id.descr: ID of an existing thread to add this email to. Leave empty to start a new thread.
auth.description:
To get your LobsterMail API key:
1. Sign up or log in at **https://lobstermail.ai**
2. Go to **Settings → API Keys**
3. Click **Create New Key**
4. Copy the key — it starts with `lm_sk_test_` (sandbox) or `lm_sk_live_` (production)

Need help? See https://lobstermail.ai/docs
description: Email infrastructure for AI agents — create inboxes, send and receive email, search, threads, and webhooks.
triggers.email_bounced.description: Triggers when an outbound email fails to deliver. Use this to update CRM records, retry with a different address, or alert your team.
triggers.email_bounced.props.inbox_id.de: Limit results to a specific inbox. Leave empty to search all inboxes.
triggers.email_sent.description: Triggers when an outbound email is successfully delivered. Use for audit logs, CRM updates, or confirming delivery.
triggers.email_sent.props.inbox_id.descr: Limit results to a specific inbox. Leave empty to search all inboxes.
triggers.new_email.description: Triggers instantly when a new email is received in an inbox.
triggers.new_email.props.inbox_id.descri: Limit results to a specific inbox. Leave empty to search all inboxes.
triggers.new_thread.description: Triggers when a brand-new conversation (thread) is started in an inbox.
triggers.new_thread.props.inbox_id.descr: Limit results to a specific inbox. Leave empty to search all inboxes.
triggers.thread_reply.description: Triggers when someone replies to an existing email thread. Useful for follow-up and support automation.
triggers.thread_reply.props.inbox_id.des: Limit results to a specific inbox. Leave empty to search all inboxes.
